info.title: DependencyGraph
info.description: Scans a folder for .csproj files and exports their project/package dependencies as JSON, an interactive HTML graph or an HTML table.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Scans a folder for .csproj files and exports their project/package dependencies.

options.name: --root
options.description: Root source folder to recursively scan for .csproj files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to the output file that will receive the discovered dependency graph.

options.name: --type
options.description: Output format: 'json', 'html' or 'table'. Defaults to 'html' when omitted. [default: html]

options.name: --tags
options.description: Tag definitions used to classify projects by relative path. Format: 'name=pattern1,pattern2;name2=pattern3'. A project is tagged with 'name' when its relative path contains any of the patterns (case-insensitive substring match). Example: --tags "tests=test;tools=/tools;sample=sample,demo"
